description: List the tables and their columns staged on a DataCanvas by paleobiology_search_occurrences. Call this before paleobiology_dataframe_query to discover the exact table_name and column names to reference in SQL.

canvas_id.description: Canvas id returned by paleobiology_search_occurrences when its result spilled.

name: paleobiology_dataframe_describe

error.description: Present when the call failed. Absent on success.

code.description: JSON-RPC error code for this failure.

reason.description: Machine-readable failure mode. Declared by this tool: `canvas_disabled`: DataCanvas is not enabled on this deployment (CANVAS_PROVIDER_TYPE is not duckdb). Other values are possible when a failure originates below the handler.

recovery.description: Actionable next step for the caller.

message.description: Human-readable description of what went wrong.

items.description: A table staged on the canvas, with its columns.
A column in the staged table.

nullable.description: True when the column may contain nulls.

type.description: SQL column type, e.g. VARCHAR, DOUBLE, BIGINT.

name.description: Table name — reference this in paleobiology_dataframe_query SQL.

row_count.description: Number of rows in the table.

title: paleobiology-mcp-server: describe staged canvas tables
